content: crypto-js is DISCONTINUED (README: active development discontinued, no longer maintained; last release 4.2.0 in 2020) and its pure-JS PBKDF2 at 210k iterations takes seconds on low-end phones. Replacement: react-native-quick-crypto 1.1.7 (Nitro/JSI, peers expo >=48, nitro >=0.31.2, quick-base64 >=3; AES-256-CBC, PBKDF2-SHA256, HMAC-SHA256 native speed; dev build already required). Zero-native alternative: @noble/hashes + @noble/ciphers (maintained, audited, pure JS, slower KDF). OWASP 2024 recommends 600k iterations for PBKDF2-SHA256.
